name: list_projects
title: List projects
description: List the Omnix projects this connection can see, most recently edited first. Use the ids with the other tools.

name: get_project
title: Get project overview
description: Read a whole project across all six tools at once: every canvas (layers), sequence (tracks and clips), code workspace (files, notebook cells), document (outline) and deck (slides), plus session-memory notes. Start here before editing.

includeTree.description: Also return the full node tree as text (ids and labels).

name: get_node
title: Read a node
description: Read one node (layer, clip, block, slide element, file, cell...) with its properties and children ids. Large arrays such as brush points are summarized.

name: get_history
title: Read history
description: List recent changes on the current branch: who made them (human or AI), when, and what. Useful to see what the user did since your last turn.

name: get_selection
title: Get the user's selection
description: What the user currently has selected in Omnix (layers, clips, blocks, slide elements) and where they are looking. Use it to resolve "this" and "here".

name: list_notes
title: Read session memory
description: Read the project's session memory: decisions, prompts and rejected options recorded by people and AI. Read this when resuming work so you do not repeat rejected ideas.

name: render_preview
title: Render a preview image
description: See the work: render a canvas, single layer, video/animation frame at a time, slide, or the whole project to an image. Use it to check your edits visually before handing back to the user.

nodeId.description: Canvas, layer, sequence, clip, slide or deck id. Omit for a project thumbnail.

name: create_project
title: Create a project
description: Start a new project for the user in one of the six tools (image, video, animation, code, document, slides). Other documents can be added to it later with add_document. The new project allows AI from the start because the user asked for it through you; it is added to this connection automatically.

primaryTool.description: The tool the project opens in

name: add_document
title: Add a document to a project
description: Add another canvas, video or animation sequence, code workspace, document or slideshow to an existing project, so work can flow between tools in one place.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: update_node
title: Change properties of anything
description: Set (or unset) properties on any node: a layer, clip, track, sequence, canvas, block, slide, slide element, code file or cell. Use get_node to see current properties. Values are validated against the node type; for example a layer accepts opacity 0..1, blendMode, x, y, rotation; a clip accepts start, in, out, x, y, scale, opacity, volume. Prefer the tool-specific tools when one fits.

label.description: Short description of the change for the history

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: move_node
title: Move or reorder a node
description: Move a node to another parent or position: reorder layers (bottom to top), move a layer into a group, a clip to another track, a block or slide to another position. Index counts children of the new parent after removing the node.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: delete_node
title: Delete something
description: Delete a node and everything inside it (a layer, clip, track, block, slide, slide element, code file, cell or a whole document). Deleting is recorded in history and can be undone.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: apply_operations
title: Apply raw operations
description: Advanced: apply a list of scene-graph operations as one change (create, delete, update, move, listInsert, listRemove, listUpdate, batch). Use it for edits no specific tool covers. Created nodes need full props or defaults; ids you choose must be unique (letters, digits, _ and -). Everything is validated before it applies.

label.description: What the change does, for the history

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: undo
title: Undo your last change
description: Undo the most recent change you (this connection) made in a project. People's changes are never undone by this tool.

output.undone: Move the title to the lower third

name: start_new_proposal
title: Start a new proposal
description: In edit-with-approval mode your changes stack into one open proposal so the user reviews related edits together. Call this before starting an unrelated change (or an alternative option) so it becomes a separate proposal.

name: add_note
title: Add to session memory
description: Record a decision, a prompt that worked, a rejected option or a reminder in the project's session memory, so the next session (yours, another AI's or a person's) can pick up where this one left off. Follows the connection's permission mode: in edit-with-approval mode the note waits for the user to approve it.

kind.description: decision: something agreed; prompt: an instruction worth reusing; rejected: an option the user turned down; note: anything else.

text.description: The note. Keep it to one or two sentences.

input.text: Seb preferred the warm palette over the neon one.

name: list_assets
title: Search the asset library
description: Search images, video, audio, LUTs and fonts in the asset library by name, tag or kind. Asset ids are content hashes and can be placed into any project.

projectId.description: Only assets used in this project.

name: get_asset
title: Get asset details
description: Metadata for one asset: dimensions, duration, frame rate, audio, color profile, EXIF summary and where it is used.

name: import_asset
title: Import a file from a URL
description: Download an image, video, audio file, font or LUT from a public URL (or a data: URL) into the asset library, optionally attached to a project, so it can be placed in canvases, timelines, documents and slides. Identical files are stored once.

name: tag_asset
title: Rename or tag an asset
description: Rename an asset or replace its tags, to keep the library searchable.

name: image_add_layer
title: Add a layer
description: Add a layer to a canvas: raster (an image asset), text, shape (vector shapes), fill (solid color) or group. New layers go on top unless you pass index (0 = bottom). Coordinates are canvas pixels from the top-left.

parentId.description: A group layer to put it in (default: the canvas)

assetId.description: raster: the image asset to place

width.description: raster: displayed width (default: the image size)

shapes.description: shape: vector shapes in canvas coordinates

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: image_add_adjustment
title: Add an adjustment layer
description: Add a non-destructive adjustment layer that changes everything below it: curves, levels, hueSaturation (hue -180..180, saturation and lightness -100..100), colorBalance, brightnessContrast (-100..100), temperature (amount -100 cool .. 100 warm), invert, or lut (a .cube asset). Put it inside a group to affect only that group.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: image_add_filter
title: Add a smart filter
description: Add a non-destructive filter to a layer (gaussianBlur {radius}, sharpen {amount}, noise {amount}, pixelate {size}, grayscale, sepia, vignette {amount}, emboss, edgeDetect). Filters stay editable and can be turned off.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: image_set_selection
title: Select an area
description: Set the canvas selection to a rectangle, ellipse or polygon (canvas pixels), or clear it with null. Selections drive fills, masks and content-aware fill, and the user sees them.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: image_select_smart
title: Select by color or object
description: Make a selection from the pixels: "color" selects similar colors starting at a point (magic wand), "object" finds the main object inside a box. The result becomes the canvas selection.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: image_mask_layer
title: Mask a layer
description: Give a layer a mask from the current selection (shows only the selected area; inverted hides it instead), or remove its mask with from: "none".

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: image_remove_background
title: Remove a layer's background
description: Find the subject of a pixel layer and hide its background with an editable layer mask (nothing is erased). Use method "chroma" with keyColor for green or blue screens.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: image_content_aware_fill
title: Content-aware fill
description: Fill the selected area with texture taken from its surroundings (removes objects, blemishes or text). The result goes on a new layer above, so the original stays intact.

selection.description: Area to fill (default: the current selection)

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: image_paint
title: Paint strokes
description: Paint brush (or eraser) strokes onto a pixel layer. Points are canvas pixels; pressure 0..1 thins the stroke. Strokes stay editable data on the layer.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: image_resize_canvas
title: Resize or crop the canvas
description: Change the canvas size. anchor says where existing content stays (0,0 top-left; 0.5,0.5 centre); offsetX/offsetY instead move content by exact pixels (negative values crop from the top-left). Layers move with the content.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_add_clip
title: Put media on the timeline
description: Place a video, audio or image asset on a track. Without trackId the first track of the right kind is used (one is created if needed). Without start the clip goes after the last clip on that track. in/out pick the part of the source to use (seconds). The sequence grows to fit.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_add_title
title: Add a title or caption
description: Add text on screen for a time range: a title (large, centred, fades in and out) or a caption (bottom of the frame, with a backing box). Goes on the top title track.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_edit_clip
title: Split, trim, move or delete a clip
description: Timeline edits on one clip. split: cut at a sequence time into two clips. trim: move the in or out edge by delta seconds (positive shortens the in edge, lengthens the out edge). move: change start time and optionally track. delete: remove it; with ripple the later clips on that track close the gap.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_set_speed
title: Change clip speed
description: Play a clip faster or slower (0.1 to 16, 1 = normal), optionally in reverse. With ripple, later clips move to make room. For gradual speed changes pass ramp: points of normalized clip time 0..1 and speed.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_set_keyframe
title: Animate a property
description: Set a keyframe on a clip or animation layer: property x, y, scale, rotation, opacity, volume (dB, audio) or blur at a time relative to the clip or layer start. Between keyframes values move with the easing of the earlier keyframe. Pass remove: true to delete the keyframe at that time.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_set_transition
title: Set a transition
description: Set or clear the transition at the start (in) or end (out) of a clip: crossfade, dip-to-black, wipe-left, wipe-right, slide-left or zoom, with duration and easing.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_add_effect
title: Add a clip effect
description: Add an effect to a clip: colorGrade {exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature, tint} or a filter (gaussianBlur, sharpen, noise, pixelate, grayscale, sepia, vignette, emboss, edgeDetect). For green screens set backgroundRemoval with update_node, or use video_remove_background.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_remove_background
title: Remove a clip's background
description: Cut the subject out of a video clip: "chroma" keys out a color (green or blue screen; set keyColor), "auto" separates the subject from a mostly still background. Clips on lower tracks show through.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_add_track
title: Add a track
description: Add a video, audio, title, effect or animation track to a sequence. Visual tracks go on top unless you pass index (0 = top).

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_mix_track
title: Mix a track
description: Audio mixing for a track: gain in dB (-60..12), pan (-1 left .. 1 right), mute, and ducking (lower this track while another track, usually dialogue, has sound).

duckUnder.description: Track id that triggers ducking, or null to turn ducking off

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: video_generate_captions
title: Generate captions
description: Listen to the sequence's dialogue and add timed captions on a Captions track. With a speech-to-text service configured they contain the words; otherwise they are timed slots where speech was detected, ready for text.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: anim_add_layer
title: Add an animation layer
description: Add an animation layer (a drawing that can be frame-by-frame, tweened with keyframes, rigged with bones or moved along a path) to an animation track. Pass shapes for its first drawing, in layer coordinates around its anchor.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: anim_add_frame
title: Add a drawing frame
description: Add a frame-by-frame drawing to an animation layer. hold is how many timeline frames it stays on screen. index inserts it at a position (default: after the last frame).

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: anim_set_motion_path
title: Move along a path
description: Make an animation layer follow a path over its duration (points in sequence coordinates, origin at the frame centre). orientToPath turns the layer to face along the path. Pass points: [] to remove the path.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: anim_rig
title: Rig and pose bones
description: Bone rigging for a character layer. addBones appends bones (parentId null for a root at x, y; angle in radians relative to the parent; length in pixels). pose records joint angles (radians, by bone id) at a time in seconds from the layer start; poses in between are interpolated with the easing.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: doc_insert_markdown
title: Write into a document
description: Insert Markdown into a document as editable blocks: headings, paragraphs, lists, to-dos ([ ] / [x]), quotes, code fences, tables, dividers, images (![alt](asset:<assetId>)) and live links (!embed[chart](<cellId>), !embed[canvas](<id>), !embed[slide](<id>), !embed[sequence-frame](<id>@<seconds>), !embed[asset](<assetId>)). Inserts after afterBlockId, at the start with afterBlockId null, or at the end by default.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

input.markdown:
## Results

Sales grew **12%**.

- North led
- South recovered

name: doc_edit_block
title: Edit a block
description: Change a document block directly: its text (inline markdown), type (heading with level 1-3, paragraph, bullet, numbered, todo, quote, code), indent level, checked state, code language, table rows or named style. To propose a change for review instead, use doc_suggest.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: doc_suggest
title: Suggest an edit
description: Propose a change to a document block that people (or other AIs) accept or reject: replace its text, insert a new block after it, or delete it. Suggestions appear in the margin with a word-level diff and never change the text until accepted. Prefer this to doc_edit_block when the user should decide.

reason.description: Why, in one sentence (shown to the reviewer)

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: doc_resolve_suggestion
title: Accept or reject a suggestion
description: Accept a suggested edit (optionally with adjusted text) so it changes the document, or reject it with a reason. Suggestions come from people and AIs alike; get_node on the document lists them.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: add_comment
title: Comment
description: Leave a comment pinned to something: a document block (optionally on a quoted phrase inside it), a slide or slide element (x, y), a layer or canvas (x, y), a clip or sequence (time in seconds), or a code file (line). Use it to ask questions or flag issues without changing the work. Reply to an existing comment with replyTo.

quote.description: Document blocks: the exact phrase the comment is about

replyTo.description: Comment id to reply to (nodeId not needed)

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

input.text: Is this year over year or quarter over quarter?

name: doc_set_style
title: Change a document style
description: Change a named style for the whole document (body, h1, h2, h3, quote, code, caption or a new name): font family, size (pt), weight, color, line height, spacing before/after (pt) and italic.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: slides_add_slide
title: Add a slide
description: Add a slide built from a layout (title, title-body, two-column, section, image-full, blank) with its placeholders filled: title, subtitle and body (inline markdown; "- " lines become bullets). Optional speaker notes. index 0 is first; default is the end.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: slides_add_element
title: Add to a slide
description: Add an element to a slide: text (inline markdown), image or video (asset), shape (rect, ellipse, line, polygon or path in its own width×height frame), chart (a chart spec; bar, line, area, pie or scatter) or embed (a live link to a Code Grounds chart or output, a canvas, an animation or video frame, or another slide). Position and size are deck pixels.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: slides_edit_slide
title: Change a slide
description: Change a slide: layout (moves placeholders), background color, speaker notes, transition (none, fade, push, wipe, zoom with duration and easing), hidden, or position in the deck. Duplicate it with duplicate: true.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: slides_animate
title: Animate a slide element
description: Add a build animation to a slide element: fade-in, fly-in, zoom-in, pulse, spin, fade-out or fly-out. trigger "on-enter" plays when the slide appears; "on-click" waits for click number `click` (1 = first click; default: the next click); "with-previous" plays with the element's previous animation. delay and duration are seconds. clear: true removes all of the element's animations first.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: slides_set_theme
title: Change the slideshow theme
description: Apply a theme to the whole deck: a preset (Calm, Midnight, Paper, Bold, Forest) or custom colors and fonts. Slides keep their own background overrides.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: slides_outline
title: Read a slideshow
description: Every slide in order with its layout, notes, hidden state and elements (type, role, text, box, animations) so you can plan edits.

name: export_file
title: Export a file
description: Export a canvas or layer (png, jpeg, webp, avif, svg, psd), a video or animation sequence (a preset id such as youtube-1080p or instagram-reel, or gif, apng, webm, mp4, lottie, spritesheet; srt or vtt for captions), a document (docx, pdf, md, html), a slideshow (pptx, pdf, pdf-notes, png) or a code workspace (zip, ipynb). Returns a download link that works for 24 hours, and the file is also saved in the asset library.

name: code_write_file
title: Write a code file
description: Create a file in a code workspace, or replace its whole content if the path exists. For small changes to a long file use code_edit_file. Paths are relative (for example "src/app.py" or "data/sales.csv").

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: code_edit_file
title: Edit part of a code file
description: Replace exact text in a file. Each find must occur exactly once (or pass all: true to replace every occurrence). Edits apply in order. Use get_node on the file to read it first.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: code_add_cell
title: Add a notebook cell
description: Add a code or markdown cell to a notebook, after afterCellId (default: at the end). Python cells can call omnix.chart(type=..., labels=..., series=[...]) and omnix.table(...) for rich outputs that documents and slides can link to.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds

name: code_run
title: Run code
description: Run a file, a notebook cell or a snippet in the workspace sandbox (Python, JavaScript or TypeScript; no network unless the workspace allows it; time and memory limits apply) and get its output. In autonomous mode cell outputs are saved to the notebook (and update everything linked to them); otherwise you see the results without changing the project.

name: code_place_output
title: Use a cell's output in a document or slide
description: Link a notebook cell's chart, table or output live into a document (as a block after afterBlockId, default at the end) or onto a slide (at x, y, w, h). When the cell runs again, the document and slide update.

changes.description: How many changes the proposal now holds
